title: Abaphulaphuli Abafihlakeleyo Ababekholelwa
intro: Kwindibano engcwele, kwafika indibano emangalisayo ivela kwindawo engabonakaliyo. Betsalwa yingxolo yento emangalisayo, baphulaphula ingxolo eyayiza kuqinisekisa ikamva labo ngonaphakade. Ubungqina babo buhlala bubobunye bobona bukhethekileyo kwizibhalo zikaThixo.
clues: Singabantu abavela kummandla ongabonwayo ngabaninzi, kwaye size njengeqela.
Saya kwindibano ukuze sive into emangalisayo.
Xa sifika, samamela ingoma eyasishiya simangalisiwe.
Sivumile ngokuphandle ukuba abanye phakathi kwethu bangamalungisa abanye abanjalo.
Sasisazi ukuba asinakukwazi ukuwubaleka ummiselo kaThixo emhlabeni, okanye ngokubalekela esibhakabhakeni.
Sathi sakuva ulwalathiso, salukholelwa; nabani na okholelwa eNkosini yakhe akayi koyika ukulahlekelwa okanye umthwalo.
arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
verse: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways. (72:11)
